children: Dell Technologies agreed to sell $5.0 billion of senior notes across four maturities to refinance its 2026 first-lien notes and for general corporate purposes.
Notes guaranteed jointly and severally by Dell Technologies, Denali Intermediate and Dell Inc.; closing expected Sept 15, 2026, subject to conditions.
Net proceeds intended to repay outstanding 4.900% First Lien Notes due 2026; remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes, possibly other debt repayment.
